test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

China expects to welcome back Indian students to __resume__ their studies in the country.
solution:
The correct answer is '**cease'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym for the given word '**resume**' is '**cease(समाप्त होना / बंद करना)'.**
 
• The meaning of the word **resume **is '**to begin again or continue after a pause or interruption**'.
 
• The meaning of the word **cease** is '**to stop or end**'.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is '**cease**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Usher**- to take or show somebody where to go. **(मार्गदर्शक)**
 
• **Presume**- to think that something is true even if you do not know for sure.**(मान लेना / धारणा करना)**
 
• **Announce**- to make something known publicly and officially.**(घोषित करना / घोषणा करना)**
 
 

3a:T457,
The correct answer is **No error**.
